action-id.description: The action identifier reported by the Organizations Events API or an export column.

activity.description: The activity label reported in an Atlassian Administration CSV export.

actor-email.description: The reported email address of the actor.

actor-email-raw.description: The actor's email field when Atlassian reports a label, redaction, or another value.

actor-id.description: The reported Atlassian identifier of the actor.

actor-name.description: The reported name or label of the actor.

app-id.description: The reported identifier of the app that triggered the event.

app-name.description: The reported app name or product label.

app-type.description: The app type reported for the actor.

auth-type.description: The reported authentication type used for the action.

city.description: The city Atlassian reported for the source address.

country.description: The country Atlassian reported for the source address.

event-id.description: The audit event identifier reported by Atlassian.

event-time.description: The event timestamp normalized to UTC when a time and offset are available.

event-time-raw.description: The original event time, or the date and time joined from the CSV columns.

ip-src.description: The reported source address as a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

location.description: The reported location label or legacy API geo value.

message-format.description: The declared format of the encrypted audit message.

on-behalf-of-email.description: The email address of the account on whose behalf the actor acted.

on-behalf-of-email-raw.description: The reported delegated account's email field when it cannot be represented as an email.

on-behalf-of-id.description: The Atlassian identifier of the account on whose behalf the actor acted.

on-behalf-of-name.description: The reported name of the account on whose behalf the actor acted.

organization.description: The organization name reported in the export.

organization-id.description: The organization identifier from the export or supplied by the analyst.

processed-time-raw.description: The original API processedAt timestamp from an events stream response.

raw-record.description: The complete audit record as JSON. CSV cell values remain strings.

raw-record-fragment.description: One JSON-encoded string fragment of a large raw audit record, ordered by the part number in the comment.

region.description: The region Atlassian reported for the source address.

site.description: A reported or analyst-supplied site name or URL.

site-id.description: A reported Atlassian site or cloud ID.

source-address.description: The original source IP field, including any reported redaction.

source-format.description: The format of the saved audit export.

token-id.description: The authentication token identifier reported by Atlassian.

token-label.description: The reported label of the authentication token.

unit.description: The unit name reported in the export.

unit-id.description: The unit identifier reported in the export.

description: An Atlassian Cloud organization or site audit event with the reported activity, actor, scope and source context.
name: atlassian-audit-event
